I'll review PLAN2.P3.1 read-only from the listed plan artifacts, normative sections, and the actual source and tests they name. No edits, tests, shell, or MCP.Plan artifacts are loaded. Next I’ll read the normative sections and the candidate source they name.Normative contracts are in. I’ll read the candidate source, tests, and the access/locator dependency closure next.**GREEN.** P3.1’s core security boundary matches the owned contract. No material correctness, security, public-API, or test defect in this scope.

Actor identity is fixed at construction. `Actor::user()` takes the Eloquent morph and key, or the Authenticatable class and auth identifier, and rejects an Authorizable with no stable id and the system type `vaulter:system` (`packages/core/src/ValueObjects/Access/Actor.php:20-36`). `authorizable()` refuses a later identity change (`Actor.php:49-62`). PHP serialization of a live `Actor` throws (`Actor.php:73-76`). `ActorRef` trims the system reason, requires it to be nonempty and at most 191 bytes, and rejects a system id or a reason on a user ref (`ActorRef.php:20-32`). `OperationContext` keeps the drive’s persisted raw key in `driveId()`, rejects an unpersisted drive, and accepts only a nonempty correlation id of at most 191 bytes with no ASCII control characters (`OperationContext.php:21-40`).

`NodeLocator` ignores the caller’s attributes, relations, and connection. It loads the configured node model on the Vaulter connection and filters `drive_id` with that captured key (`NodeLocator.php:66-82`). The default find excludes soft-deleted rows; trash inclusion is the explicit `includeTrashed` argument (`NodeLocator.php:20-32`).

Scope runs before the system branch on `authorize`, `authorizeCreate`, `visible`, and `abilities` (`OperationGuard.php:26-38`, `41-55`, `61-79`, `82-93`, `96-100`). A missing `View` becomes `NodeNotFoundException`; a missing later ability becomes `PermissionDeniedException` (`OperationGuard.php:116-120`). Create requires `View`, `canCreateInWorkspace()`, and `Ability::Create` (`OperationGuard.php:44-51`). Batch visibility rebinds through `findMany`, keeps input order, and uses `evaluateMany` with `GrantSet::superDenied()` when a row is absent (`OperationGuard.php:61-77`). Ability flags are the fresh grant projection (`OperationGuard.php:85-93`). Nothing stores an ACL decision. `OperationKind` is only `Metadata`, `Mutation`, `ContentEgress`, and `Purge` (`OperationKind.php:8-14`) and is not a scanner capability. `MissingActorException` is `actor_required` / 401 (`MissingActorException.php:17-24`).

The new tests cover those branches, including forged node identity, foreign scope on every system surface, both create gates, revoke-between-calls, and batch/scalar agreement for the same fresh grants. Recorded V1 is 75 passed, V2 is 6 passed, and Arch is 75 passed. NC-SCOPE and NC-VIEW each have a named nonempty RED and a restored GREEN on the original source hashes. Profile policy, content scanning, tenancy, and the existing handle stay inactive seams owned by later items.
